message.content:
Oversized wool coat in deep charcoal gray (#36454F), a generous straight cut falling to mid-thigh for coverage against the driving snow.  
Matte black leather ankle boots with a chunky lug sole and water-repellent treatment to handle salted roads.  
A thick cashmere scarf in navy blue (#000080) wrapped twice around the neck for warmth during the long walk.  
Why this outfit works: The bulky wool coat provides essential insulation against the -15 °C temperature while protecting her from melting snow and road spray. Chunky leather boots are non-negotiable here, offering the traction needed on icy, salted pavement without slipping. The dark color palette keeps warmth reflected inward and prevents showing every speck of falling snow, maintaining a professional silhouette under heavy weather conditions.
